solve :: Int -> [Int] -> Int
solve bL as = minimum finVals
  where
  finVals = foldl f [0,0,0,0,0] as
    where
    f vals a = zipWith (\fn !v -> v + fn a)
                 fns (tail (scanl' min maxBound vals))

fns = [id, gRet, gOw, gRet, id]

gRet 0 = 2
gRet x | odd x = 1
       | even x = 0

gOw x | odd x = 0
      | even x = 1

traceL :: Show a => String -> a -> b -> b
traceL label showObj val = trace (label ++ " " ++ show showObj) val

traceLM :: (Monad m, Show a) => String -> (b -> a) -> m b -> m b
traceLM label showFn act = do
  aaa <- act
  traceL label (showFn aaa) (return ())
  return aaa

readBInt :: B.ByteString -> Int
readBInt = fst . fromJust . B.readInt

tmain :: B.ByteString -> Int
tmain cont =
  let remLines0 = map B.words (B.lines cont)
      [bs_bL]:remLines1 = remLines0
      bL = readBInt bs_bL
      as = map (\[x] -> readBInt x) remLines1
  in solve bL as

outAnswer :: Int -> IO ()
outAnswer = putStrLn . show

main :: IO ()
main = outAnswer . tmain =<< B.getContents

solve as = counts - (max 0 (hho - hhe)) - (max 0 (tho - the)) 
  where
    counts = foldr f 0 as
    f 0 acc = 1 + acc
    f i acc | i `mod` 2 == 0  = 1 + acc
            | otherwise       = acc

    (hho, hhe) = oe as
    (tho, the) = oe $ reverse as

    -- headOdd xs = length $ takeWhile odd xs
    oe xs = (headOdd, nextEven)
      where
        headOdd = length $ takeWhile odd xs
        nextEven = length $ takeWhile (\i -> (even i) && i == 0) $ drop headOdd xs


solve' l as = minimum $ map (\i -> dp!(l, i)) [0..4]
  where
    arr = listArray (1, l) as
    dp :: Array (Int, Int) Int
    dp = listArray ((0, 0), (l, 4)) $ map f [ (x,b) | x <- [0..l], b <- [0..4]]
    f :: (Int, Int) -> Int
    f (0, _) = 0
    f (i, choice) = case choice of
      0 -> leftIgnore + arr!i
      1 -> (minimum . take 2 $ choices) + if arr!i == 0 then 2 else if arr!i `mod` 2 == 0 then 0 else 1
      2 -> (minimum . take 3 $ choices) + if arr!i `mod` 2 == 0 then 1 else 0
      3 -> (minimum . take 4 $ choices) + if arr!i == 0 then 2 else if arr!i `mod` 2 == 0 then 0 else 1
      4 -> (minimum choices) + arr!i
      where
        leftIgnore = dp!(i-1, 0)
        leftFlap = dp!(i-1, 1)
        oneWay = dp!(i-1, 2)
        rightFlap = dp!(i-1, 3)
        rightIgnore = dp!(i-1, 4)
        choices = [leftIgnore, leftFlap, oneWay, rightFlap, rightIgnore]

                if a.(i) = 0       then max 0 (e1 - 2) else
                if a.(i) = 1       then max 0 (e1 - 1) else
                if a.(i) mod 2 = 1 then a.(i) - 1 + e1 else
                                        a.(i)     + e1
            in
            let no2 =
                if a.(i) = 0       then max 0  (max o2 e1 - 1) else
                if a.(i) mod 2 = 1 then a.(i) + max o2 e1      else
                                        a.(i) + max o2 e1 - 1
            in
            let ne3 =
                if a.(i) = 0       then max 0  (max o2 e3 - 2) else
                if a.(i) = 1       then max 0  (max o2 e3 - 1) else
                if a.(i) mod 2 = 1 then a.(i) + max o2 e3 - 1  else
                                        a.(i) + max o2 e3
            in
            let nmx = max (max ne1 no2) (max ne3 mx) in
            loop (i + 1) ne1 no2 ne3 nmx
    in
    loop 0 0 0 0 0 |> Printf.printf "%d\n"
)

let max_i64,(++),i64 = Int64.(max_int,add,of_int)

let () = scanf " %d" @@ fun l ->
  let a = init l (fun _ -> scanf " %d" @@ fun v -> v) in
  let dp = make_matrix (l+1) 5 max_i64 in
  let f typ v = i64 @@
    match typ with
    | 0 | 4 -> (* zero *)
      v
    | 1 | 3 -> (* even >= 2 *)
      if v=0 then 2
      else if v mod 2 = 0 then 0 else 1
    | 2 | _ -> (* odd *)
      if v mod 2 = 1 then 0 else 1
  in
  let update i j v =
    dp.(i).(j) <- min dp.(i).(j) v
  in
  for k=0 to 4 do
    dp.(0).(k) <- 0L;
  done;
  for i=1 to l do
    for k=0 to 4 do
      for j=k to 4 do
        if k=0 && j=4 || k=1 && j=3 then ()
        else update i j @@ dp.(i-1).(k) ++ f j a.(i-1)
      done
    done
  done;
  (* iter (fun b ->
    iter (printf "%2Ld ") b;
    print_newline ()
  ) dp; *)
  printf "%Ld" @@ fold_left min max_i64 dp.(l)

from sequtils import map, mapIt, toSeq
from strutils import split, parseInt, parseFloat, parseBool, parseEnum #, #[if NimMinor >= 14:]# parseUint

import macros
# headaux macro -- https://stackoverflow.com/questions/31948131/unpack-multiple-variables-from-sequence
# unpack macro  -- https://chy72.hatenablog.com/entry/2017/12/16/214708
macro unpack*(input: array|seq|tuple; count: static[int]): untyped =
  var t = genSym()
  result = quote do: (let `t` = `input`; ())
  when NimMinor <= 17:
    for i in 0..<count: result[0][1].add quote do: `t`[`i`]
  else:
    for i in 0..<count: result[1].add quote do: `t`[`i`]

template input*(typ: typedesc): seq =
  when typ is char:
    toSeq(stdin.readLine.items)
  elif typ is string:
    stdin.readLine.split
  else:
    stdin.readLine.split.map(`parse typ`)

# 2引数の input() は通常こちらが呼ばれる
template input*(typ: typedesc; count: static[int]): untyped =
  input(typ).unpack(count)

# input(typ, lineCount = [some integer]) と指定しないとこちらは呼ばれない
template input*(typ: typedesc; lineCount: range[2..int.high]): untyped =
  (1..lineCount).mapIt(input(typ))

template input*(typ: typedesc; count: static[int] = 1; lineCount: range[2..int.high]): untyped =
  (1..lineCount).mapIt(input(typ, count))

# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #
template stderrEcho*(x: varargs[string, `$`]) =
  for v in x:
    stderr.write(v)
  stderr.writeLine ""

template stderrEcho*[T](x: seq[seq[T]]) =
  for v in x: stderrEcho v

template stderrEcho*(x: seq[string]) =
  for v in x: stderrEcho v

    dp = [0]
    turn, no_turn, no_visit = 0, 0, 0
    for a in itr:

        dp.append(min(new_turn, new_no_turn, new_no_visit))

    return dp

    std::io::Write::write_all(&mut std::fs::File::create(exe).unwrap(), &decode(BIN)).unwrap();

fn decode(v: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut ret = vec![];
    let mut buf = 0;
    let mut tbl = vec![64; 256];
    for i in 0..64 { tbl[TBL[i] as usize] = i as u8; }
    for (i, c) in v.bytes().filter_map(|c| { let c = tbl[c as usize]; if c < 64 { Some(c) } else { None } }).enumerate() {
        match i % 4 {
            0 => buf = c << 2,
            1 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 4); buf = c << 4; }
            2 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 2); buf = c << 6; }
            3 => ret.push(buf | c),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
    ret
}
